$comment: Pinned upstream resources (IMPLEMENTATION.md §3, §8.2; verified in task 0.3, see docs/deps-verification.md). Keys are the resource folder names as ensured in server.cfg. scripts/fetch-deps.mjs clones repo@commit into resources/[upstream]/<key>; mode REFERENCE is recorded but not fetched (bub-mdt: code reference only; qbx_prison: verified, not to be run; xt-prison: installed from its release zip, called only). 'tag' + 'release' are set where the upstream's documented install path is a release zip (built web UI / dist not in git): the commit is the tag's commit and the server must run the release zip of that tag, the git checkout only serves patches and review. Never track 'latest'; bump commit (+tag/release) and re-run fetch-deps + apply-patches.

oxmysql.notes: Release zip is the documented install (README, Qbox txAdmin recipe); git has no built dist/. HEAD 030d3bd (2026-07-03) is 21 commits ahead, incl. a TINY/BIT typecast change (887d841). DATETIME -> epoch ms parsed in the FXServer host's local zone (src/utils/typeCast.ts:30-39), TINYINT(1) -> boolean.

ox_lib.notes: Release zip is the documented install (web/build not in git). overextended chosen over CommunityOx: every CommunityOx HEAD is an ancestor of overextended HEAD. HEAD b8f5a04 (2026-09-04) is 8 commits ahead incl. 'refactor(require): support ox_lib modules v2' - not pinned.

ox_inventory.notes: Release zip is the documented install (web/build not in git). PATCH = data/items.lua entries (pd_tablet, pd_ram, evidences items). The Qbox txAdmin recipe overwrites data/items.lua with Qbox's own list, so a patch made against upstream will not apply to a recipe-installed server (open question in docs/deps-verification.md).

ox_target.notes: Release zip is the documented install (README, recipe). HEAD bf03d52 only changes README.md. evidences only recommends (does not require) the noobsystems ox_target fork.

ox_doorlock.notes: README: 'The UI needs to be built - use the latest release'. createDoor/removeDoor exports were added after the tag (4e56b7e; HEAD ba092ff); getDoor, getAllDoors, getDoorFromName, setDoorState, registerHook are in v1.22.1.

qbx_core.notes: HEAD of main = what the txAdmin recipe qbox.yaml installs (download_github ref main, 165-168). qbox-lean.yaml and qbox-stable.yaml install releases/latest instead = tag v1.24.0 (c1c3ca16721cd14eb814cfb95e8f8631690d247d, 2026-08-22, 16 commits behind): re-pin to that if Rami used one of those (open question). Rami's server already runs qbx_core: this pin is the version FredPD was verified against, not something to overwrite blindly.

qbx_policejob.notes: Folder name from fxmanifest name/README title 'qbx_policejob'. The Qbox txAdmin recipes qbox.yaml/qbox-lean.yaml clone main to resources/[qbx]/qbx_police (resource name = folder name; qbox-stable.yaml does not install it): server.cfg must use whichever folder Rami's server has. No release tags; LICENSE is bare GPLv3 text (no or-later notice). Patch targets in server/main.lua: IsLeoAndOnDuty 13-18; the nine evidence handlers evidence:server:UpdateStatus 435, CreateBloodDrop 439, CreateFingerDrop 448, ClearBlooddrops 455, AddBlooddropToInventory 463, AddFingerprintToInventory 485, CreateCasing 505, ClearCasings 528, AddCasingToInventory 537 (do NOT disable 435-557 as a range: police:server:UpdateCurrentCops 514-526 sits inside and drives the client cop count); FlaggedPlateTriggered 345-362 ('#' on the source-keyed GetQBPlayers map, use pairs; same bug in UpdateCurrentCops 519). qbx_police has no jail of its own (docs §2).

qbx_prison.notes: Verified, not to be run (docs/deps-verification.md §2a, Decision 2). Exports JailPlayer(src, minutes) / ReleasePlayer(src). Unmaintained (last functional commit 2024-06-23; the 2026 commit is a repo-template chore). Security: net event qbx_prison:server:onGateHackDone (server/main.lua:77-85) calls exports.ox_doorlock:setDoorState with a client-chosen gateKey, which ox_doorlock authorises (source is nil on the export path): any client can unlock any door. Clients can also clear their own sentence (qbx_prison:server:playerEscaped 61-64, prison:server:SetJailStatus 19-21). Run only after a patch that validates gateKey against the configured gates.

xt-prison.notes: Default prison (Decision 2): all three Qbox txAdmin recipes install this release zip (releases/latest = v1.4.9) into resources/[standalone]/xt-prison. No LICENSE file (all rights reserved): call its API only, never copy or ship a patch, hence REFERENCE (not fetched). Verified at HEAD 85fd705 (2026-08-24), which differs from v1.4.9 only in configs/client.lua. API: export SetJailTime(src, minutes) (bridge/server/qbx.lua:30-47) sets state + injail metadata only; confinement = lib.callback.await('xt-prison:client:enterJail', src, minutes), release = setJailTime 0 + 'xt-prison:client:exitJail'. Client-trusting: prison:server:SetJailStatus and xt-prison:server:setJailStatus let a client zero its own sentence, so FredPD's record is the authority.

qbx_vehicles.notes: HEAD of main = what qbox.yaml installs (172-175); qbox-lean/qbox-stable install releases/latest = tag v1.4.2 (7cd0380464b4494dbc12ff5d7f9d557dd7b89524, 2024-12-19, 6 commits behind): re-pin if Rami used those. Server event qbx_vehicles:server:vehicleSaved(vehicleId); hooks via exports.qbx_vehicles:registerHook('createPlayerVehicle'|'changeVehicleOwner', fn). Required by qbx_garages.

qbx_garages.notes: HEAD of main = what qbox.yaml installs (237-240); qbox-lean/qbox-stable install releases/latest = tag v1.1.4 (1ff6effc7bff74aa56f8a66d3201419901eda4a0, 2024-11-11, 20 commits behind): re-pin if Rami used those. exports.qbx_garages:registerHook('parkVehicle'|'spawnVehicle'|'spawnedVehicle', fn) covers task 3.4 without a patch.

evidences.notes: Tag v1.3.1 = HEAD of main. Release zip is the documented install (html/dui/laptop/dist is built, not in git, so the [upstream] checkout cannot run the laptop UI); item images: releases/download/v1.3.1/item_images.zip; items from .github/setup/en_items.lua go into ox_inventory data/items.lua. No sv locale upstream. Works with upstream ox_target (the noobsystems fork is only recommended). PATCH (task 4.2, Decision 5): net evidences:syncEvidence runs any evidence method with client arguments and no permission check, incl. atItem/removeFromItem on any inventory (server/evidences/api.lua:50-59), and collect copies client metadata over the item (server/evidences/actions.lua:61-75, 92-94), so C16's item_uid is forgeable until patched: whitelist methods, atItem/removeFromItem only on inventory == source, strip reserved keys, remove.fun only removeFrom*.

ps-dispatch.notes: HEAD of main = tag 3.0.0 (8de73dd) + a README-only commit; no release zip (html/ is committed). Qbox support is through qbx_core's qb-core bridge. fxmanifest hard-includes @PolyZone files that the code never uses (lib.zones): install PolyZone or patch those 3 lines. lsn-radar is not referenced by any code (optional). Patch: TriggerEvent('fredpd:dispatch:incoming', data, src) (contracts C13) in server/main.lua before broadcastCall (line 335) and a broadcast/keybind switch (no NUI-off config flag exists).

screenshot-basic.notes: Only commit on master since 2022; git clone is the documented install and FXServer builds dist/ at start through the cfx-server-data yarn + webpack builder resources. Current Qbox recipe servers run itschip/screencapture (AGPL-3.0, provide 'screenshot-basic', same requestScreenshotUpload signature) instead: never run both.

bub-mdt.notes: Reference only (not fetched, never started): web/src/utils/fetchNui.ts, debugData.ts, server/ SQL shapes. No commits in 2026. Copied code keeps its GPL header.

qb-core.notes: QBCore framework (the target server's framework, contracts §C17). Patched only to add FredPD items to shared/items.lua for qb-inventory (patches/qb-core.*). Licence: verify header at pin.

qb-policejob.notes: QBCore police job; primary police target (patches/qb-policejob.*). The qbx_policejob patches remain for Qbox servers.

qb-inventory.notes: Bridge target for inventory=qb-inventory; used unmodified.

qb-target.notes: Bridge target for target=qb-target; used unmodified.

qb-doorlock.notes: Bridge target for doorlock=qb-doorlock; patches/qb-doorlock.10-fredpd-bridge.patch adds a server-side state-change event for the bridge (fredpd:bridge:doorChanged).
